screen.title: Conversation: Returning a rented textbook
screen.prompt: Listen to a conversation between a student and a bookstore clerk.

audio.text: Hi, I rented this chemistry textbook, and I'd like to return it early.
Sure. Just so you know, early returns don't get a partial refund.
That's fine. I found the e-book through the library, so I don't need the paper copy.
Okay. Hmm, there's some highlighting on a few pages. If there's too much, we charge a damage fee.
It was already like that when I got it. I think it says so on my receipt.
Let me check. Yes, "used, some highlighting." You're all set.

questions.stem: Why does the woman return the book early?
options: She can use a digital version instead.
She wants some of her money back.
She has dropped the chemistry course.
The book has too much highlighting.

why.en: Reason (paraphrase of "found the e-book"). B contradicts "no partial refund", which she accepts.
why.tr: Sebep ("e-kitabı buldum" parafrazı). B "kısmi iade yok" bilgisiyle çelişiyor; kadın bunu kabul ediyor.

questions.stem: Why does the woman mention her receipt?
options: To ask the clerk for a partial refund
To show that the marks were already there
To prove that she rented the book
To check the last day for returns

why.en: Function: the receipt shows the book was sold "used, some highlighting", so she avoids the damage fee.
why.tr: İşlev: makbuz kitabın "kullanılmış, biraz işaretli" verildiğini gösteriyor; hasar ücretinden kurtuluyor.
